en: Hello, we need a repair visit on the {system} system on {field}. Please tell us your first free day and a price. The lines must be flushed by {flush_date}.

why: placeholders must be exactly: {name} {pump_kw} {pump_service}

en: Hello, we need the soil test results for {field} before we finish the fertiliser plan. The last test was on {soil_test_on}. Please send them as soon as you can.
